evidence.why: User-uploaded SVG content (read via FileReader, only checked for '<svg' substring) is injected into the DOM via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with no DOMPurify/sanitize-html sanitisation.

controls_present: regex-based dangerous pattern blocklist in validators.ts (not a real sanitiser)
other_classes_observed: blocklist-based SVG sanitisation is bypassable (e.g. SVG event handler variants, nested entities) rather than true allowlist sanitisation
